sources.title: Pinned CPython3.12.14 simple statements
sources.scope: Assignment rebinding may release/destruct the previous object before the following stop clock; no measured disposal magnitude inferred.

sources.title: Pinned CPython3.12.14 time
sources.scope: perf_counter_ns is elapsed high-resolution time, including descheduling/sleep, not exclusive CPU time.

sources.title: Pinned CPython3.12.14 sys
sources.scope: sys.executable, version and optimization flags are interpreter metadata; source uses explicit optimization/debug rejection rather than relying on asserts.

sources.title: Pinned CPython3.12.14 profiler
sources.scope: Deterministic profiling is not benchmark timing; overhead is unequal for Python versus C.

sources.title: Official CPython importlib3.12 rolling documentation
sources.scope: __file__ and ModuleSpec.origin can differ and are not automatically synchronized; source paths are observed joins, not immutable loaded-code attestation.

sources.title: Official Linux kernel proc filesystem documentation
sources.scope: Own-process maps describe mapped regions and file paths; snapshot/race limits do not support historic or continuously observed attestation.
